subject: Boolean literals
notes: 'Boolean literals are of the class and category boolean' (cite.py --check 8.3.3.4.4 GR2 OK). ClassOf maps both 'B' and 'BX' prefixes to LiteralClass.Boolean; BooleanLiteralOperand tags PicCategory.Boolean; the CONSTANT arm (DataBinder.Constants.cs:223) tags PicCategory.Boolean. Both formats are ONE token (BOOLLIT), so no format can take another class. Observed: FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH(B"101") rejected COBOL1627 as a boolean-class literal (probe bl1 first run); numeric context rejects 0844 (cited test). Also witnessed by conformance:cases/15.40.3-Argument-rules/l1-fdt-argument1-boolean-literal. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2002, 2014, 2023 (boolean literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction, gated COBOL0900 at --std 85 - probe bl7; the zero-length-literal introduction edge is not derivable from the in-repo 2023 text, whose Annex E lists only the 2014->2023 delta)
